inventorySemantics: lexicons is the exact ordered 21-file source set, including the repo and sync defs files; endpoints is the exact ordered 19-method XRPC contract set and excludes defs.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Accepts an optional since revision for an incremental repository CAR.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Rejects a nonempty since until retained-history incremental CARs are implemented; it never returns a full CAR while claiming to honor since.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Parses the cursor query parameter tolerantly.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: Rejects malformed cursor values (non-decimal, negative, or greater than 2^53 - 1) at upgrade time; the reference would tolerate and reinterpret them.

intentionalDivergences.referenceBehavior: Delivers an OutdatedCursor info frame when the requested cursor predates the retained window.
intentionalDivergences.swanBehavior: The OutdatedCursor delivery path is implemented but dormant: retention is unbounded and retained_from_seq never advances until Phase 3 pruning, so the branch cannot trigger.
